articles.body:
Hey hey
Sorry, tried to find it in the previous threads but didn't manage to. 

1st turn 1710. 
*1st event card- Turmoil ✅

*2nd even card- resolve crisis (+3): elephant tail is in Maratha and face is in Delhi. Rebelion is won, Maratha is now sovereign (flag goes down), all orders in Maratha are closed. 
Now the elephant moves to the next region depicted on the top card od the draw pile, yes? Since there are no Imperial Ambitions.
The top card at the draw pile is marked- Delhi and the shape is circle (so basically the elephant just changed its direction- tail in Delhi and nose in Maratha. 

*3rd event card- resolve crisis (+0): 
Delhi attacks Maratha unsuccessfully and thus losing one tower level. 

So now basically Delhi is a strengthless capital of this empire? 

I hope my question/description was clear. I feel that this is the last missing piece of understanding the game (atleast the basic rules). 

Thank you!!

articles.body:
[q="Acer8787"]Thank you so much! 
I redirect the elephant according to the next card in the draw pile, yes? 
Even if that means to completely remove it from the area (in my case it was Mysore with triangle, so tail in Mysore and nose in Hyderabad) [/q]

Yes and yes, moving the elephant around is precisely the point. The only moment when you have something close to a security with the crisis events is when a very strong empire keeps invading neighbour regions with very low chances to lose. It will only last for a while though!
